title: The Furnace That Never Cooled
rumor: The Furnace That Never Cooled. Blackvein miners tell of a dwarven forge discovered inside an abandoned working. Though the surrounding chambers were cold and deserted, its hearth still glowed faintly, and a heavy hammer lay upon the anvil. The miners fled after hearing someone striking metal in a room they had just searched.
first_lead: An old mine map marks the abandoned working with a crude drawing of an anvil.
